summary: Purpose: deterministic implementation-acceptance evidence for one explicit execution-plans/<target>; does not implement, approve, commit, release, or deploy; default evidence_only; require complete contract or current compact-VDD prerequisite bundle plus frozen baseline/candidate manifests, typed request, action DAG, command registry, Skill-input receipt/contract; prefer commit candidate, clean HEAD only, never infer baseline as candidate^; deterministic artifact/run hashes bind contract, knowledge context, Skill-input, and input; stale bindings create successor runs, never overwrite; use canonical Locator and target-plan-scoped knowledge context, refresh bytes only without widening selection, blocking failures route knowledge-context-repair-required; Quick Dev receipt drives compact projection and stale candidate/terminal bindings return to Quick Dev; run deterministic actions and finalize deterministic_only via replayed receipts; semantic routes require immutable Bootstrap decision, inspect-lineage, bounded route, typed reentry confirmation/high-cost acknowledgement; exact reuse only bootstrap-import-envelope.v3 with current clean finalized run and lineage predecessor/head conditions; maintenance mode ai-native-single-maintainer; P2 disposed via deterministic closure; P0/P1 require Quick Dev handoff and repair-completeness; no Round 4; three rounds manual_pause, ADR-0054 closure requires protocol review/composite authority, acknowledgement, finalize closure; every finding mapping/receipt/command/path set must be hash-bound and replayable; model launch only policy-owned complex recovery triggers via external launcher; plan-local final predicate decides acceptance, not tests or Bootstrap clean alone; pure Godot unsupported; paths, schemas, policies, source reads, candidate custody, and command descriptors must validate exactly.
